methodology: `holdout` = TOI candidates whose TIC ID hosts a radial-velocity-discovered confirmed planet per the NASA Exoplanet Archive `ps` table -- ground truth entirely independent of TESS/TFOP/Gaia-informed disposition. `model_never_saw_holdout` is trained with these rows excluded entirely (a true generalization test); `model_trained_on_full_dataset` matches the production model_artifacts.pkl methodology and includes these rows in training, shown for comparison -- a large gap between the two would suggest the production model's apparent skill on similar targets is driven by memorization rather than genuine signal.
caveat: This checks recall on independently-confirmed real planets only -- it cannot by itself measure false-positive rate on this clean-label set, since RV-mass confirmation doesn't produce independently-verified negative examples the same way. See LIMITATIONS.md Section 1.1.
